title: T.S. of a microsporangium
back: Wall, outside in: epidermis, endothecium, middle layers, tapetum. The tapetum feeds developing pollen; the centre holds pollen mother cells.

title: Mature pollen grain
back: Exine of sporopollenin with germ pores; intine of cellulose and pectin; large vegetative cell + small generative cell (shed 2-celled in over 60% of angiosperms).

title: L.S. of an anatropous ovule
back: Funicle and hilum beside the micropyle (body inverted); two integuments, nucellus, embryo sac; chalaza at the far end.

title: Mature embryo sac
back: 7 cells, 8 nuclei: egg apparatus (2 synergids + egg) at the micropylar end, 3 antipodals at the chalazal end, central cell with 2 polar nuclei.

title: Dicot and grass embryos
back: Dicot: two cotyledons, plumule, hypocotyl, radicle. Grass: scutellum, coleoptile over shoot apex, coleorhiza over radicle.

title: Megaspore mother cell to embryo sac
back: One functional megaspore, three free-nuclear mitoses, then walls: monosporic, 7-celled, 8-nucleate.

title: Double fertilisation
back: Syngamy + triple fusion in one embryo sac: unique to flowering plants. The pollen tube enters a synergid first.

title: Artificial hybridisation
back: Emasculate before the anthers dehisce (stops selfing); bag with butter paper (stops stray pollen). Unisexual flowers skip emasculation.

title: Ploidy in the embryo sac
legend: n = antipodals, synergids, egg, each polar nucleus
back: If the nucellus has 24 chromosomes: endosperm 36, antipodal 12, embryo 24.

title: Autogamy vs geitonogamy vs xenogamy
back: Geitonogamy needs an agent like cross-pollination but is genetically self; only xenogamy brings new gene combinations.

title: Apomixis vs parthenocarpy
back: Both skip fertilisation. Apomixis: Asteraceae, grasses (citrus, mango show polyembryony). Parthenocarpy: banana.

title: Anther wall layers
back: Epidermis → endothecium → middle layers → tapetum (innermost, nourishes pollen).

title: 7 rooms, 8 people
back: Antipodals + central cell + egg apparatus. The central cell holds two polar nuclei, so the embryo sac is 7-celled, 8-nucleate.
